query: Economist YouGov poll generic congressional ballot registered voters

results.content:
Among registered voters, Democrats led the generic congressional ballot 42 percent to 37 percent. Independents favored Democratic candidates by 12 points.

Reuters/Ipsos surveyed 4,505 U.S. adults nationwide online July 30-August 3. The poll had a margin of error of 2 percentage points.

## Competitive Districts Show Similar Pattern

New analysis from Economist/YouGov suggested Democratic strength extends beyond heavily blue districts.
results.title: Donald Trump Gets Worrying Midterm Warning Sign Across 3 New Polls

results.content:
Polling from YouGov/Economist, Fox News and Echelon Insights shows Trump's standing among independent voters has deteriorated on job approval, the economy, immigration and broader measures of national sentiment heading into the midterms.

At the same time, Democratic candidates have opened a substantial lead among independents on the generic congressional ballot, raising questions about whether dissatisfaction with the president is beginning to translate into broader electoral risk. results.title: Five Polling Obstacles Donald Trump Is Struggling To Overcome - Newsweek

results.content:
Among registered voters asked whether they would back an unnamed Democratic or Republican candidate for the House of Representatives, 46 percent chose the Democrat and 41 percent chose the Republican, a Democratic lead of five percentage points.

The Democratic advantage on the generic congressional ballot comes as Trump's overall net approval rating sits below the lowest level recorded during his first presidency and below Biden's lowest rating while in office, according to YouGov.
